column1: # Shelf — entity-resolution labels for the keyboards category.
# One line per (offer, seed product) pair: is this listing a purchasable variant of that product?
# Written by hand from listing titles alone — before any resolver score was looked at — over the
# live corpus crawled 2026-09-11 (7,556 offers at five retailers, 50 seed products). One
# representative variant URL stands for each distinct product title.
# Policy. A listing matches when it is the seed product in any purchasable form: a colourway, an
# ISO/JIS layout, a knob or barebones variant, a limited / anniversary / collab edition, a minor
# revision (KBD75 v3.1 is a KBD75 V3). It does not match when it is a sibling model in the same
# family (Q2 HE, K2 Max, GMMK 3 Pro, One 3 SF, Tinker 75), a new generation sold as such (60HE V2
# vs 60HE+, Tofu60 Redux V2), a bundle with other goods (a keycap set, a mouse), a spare part (a
# PCB module, a top case), or an accessory. Bundles and parts are labeled non-matches on purpose:
# a rollup that counted a keyboard-plus-keycaps price as the keyboard's price would be wrong.
# Columns (tab-separated): offer_url  title  brand  model  match  note. `title` is for the reader;
# `shelf eval resolution` keys the offer by URL and the product by brand + model.
